d: Wall Street staged a massive comeback on November 23, as Nvidia's reinstatement of Jensen Huang as CEO reignited investor enthusiasm for artificial intelligence stocks. The Nasdaq Composite surged 6.51%, while the S&P 500 jumped 4.73% and the Dow Jones gained 3.01%. The Nasdaq-100 added more than $2 trillion in market value in a single session, marking a major turnaround after last week's sharp selloff. Nvidia shares soared as much as 36.6%, driving renewed optimism across the AI sector. The rally marked the biggest daily gains for the Nasdaq and S&P 500 since April 2025.
